modules.name: Solar panel
modules.desc: Makes power in daylight. Weaker the farther you are from the star.

modules.name: Water extractor
modules.desc: Pulls water from ice in the ground. Needs power.

modules.name: Greenhouse
modules.desc: Grows food and makes some oxygen. Needs water and power.

modules.name: Oxygen generator
modules.desc: Splits water into oxygen. Needs water and power.

modules.name: Habitat pod
modules.desc: Home for 2 crew. Crowded crews get grumpy.

modules.name: Comms dish
modules.desc: Keeps crew in touch with home (morale) and warns of storms.

modules.name: Radiation shield
modules.desc: Protects solar panels from harsh starlight. Two shields = full cover.

worlds.note: Cinder gets about as much sunlight as Earth.
Veil is closer to its star, but the thick clouds block much of the light.
Hollow's swollen star is bright: lots of power, but its radiation wrecks unshielded panels.
